answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 4207 Country: Pakistan Title: In the present day there is a beloved person of Allah about whom many Muslims from different countries, cities and sects had seen in their dreams with Muhammad (SAW) before they actually met him. Possible? Question: In the present day there is a beloved person of Allah about whom many Muslims from different countries, cities and sects had seen in their dreams with Muhammad (SAW) before they actually met him. Possible? Answer ID: 4207 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 881/758=B/1429) Yes, it is possible, but it is neither a proof of their acceptance nor a Shariah evidence. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
